text: When you hear "climate change", what is the first thing that comes to your mind?
Would you play a video game about climate change? What would make you stop playing after five minutes?
What kind of message in a game would make you feel lectured or manipulated?
What would you need to see in a game to trust a fact about the climate?
Which sources do you trust about the climate, and which ones do you not trust?
If a game character disagrees with you, how should they talk to you so that you keep listening?
What would make a conversation with a game character feel real to you?
Would you rather choose between answers or write your own? Why?
This mountain used to be covered with ice and now there is none. What would you want to find out up there?
What small challenge at the base camp would make you think about the climate without feeling like homework?
What would make reaching the summit feel rewarding to you?
What could actually make you change your mind about one of your opinions on climate?
